answer: Set Corbel carver lintel seal carved into the temple works ledger at the gate and the farm's arithmetic collapses: each lintel is a measured stone yield plus a guild signature, so a mason must carve. Each alias adds 116 POA of risk, so 479 aliases carry 55564 POA of risk against a single epoch's reward. A farm can print a lagoon, it can fake a sable, but it cannot backdate a trellis without the archive noticing. The gate stays shut because the key cannot be copied, only earned.
